messages:
priya: starting a targeted reprocess for telemetry aggregates for 2025-03-10 00:00-06:00 UTC. we plan 4 replayers in parallel. tagging @ryan @trent for routing/lease quota visibility.
ryan: when do you want it to start?
priya: kicking off a dry-run now to validate shard claims.
priya: dry-run failing to claim some shards repeatedly — seeing LeaseTimeoutError on shard 24/128. snippet:```
2025-03-10T12:02:03Z ERROR LeaseTimeoutError shard=24 owner=operator-42
2025-03-10T12:02:04Z WARN retrying claim (attempt=3)
```
trent: that usually points at slot eviction or per-tenant quota limits. are these replayers being preempted by low-priority work?
zara: region-eu currently has console flag `replay.low_priority_slots=4`, so replayers on low priority may get evicted under pressure.
maya: ops-bot telemetry: the jobs are pinned to pool `replay-burst`. autoscaler didn't add nodes because pool global cap=16.
ryan: i can bump job priority to `high` for 30m via internal API to let claims stabilize. want me to do it for dry-run?
priya: yes, bump for the dry-run. also note we have a non-public hint header `X-Replay-Hint: idle_first` that prefers idle nodes; not surfaced in console yet. could help too.
trent: manual priority bumps work but are risky for fairness. can we instead have a scoped rescue token that temporarily grants extra slots (e.g., +2 slots for 15m) and is auditable? avoids blanket priority changes.
zara: propose adding a minimal console flow "replay rescue" that issues a token (scope=operator-rescue, slots=2, ttl=15m) and writes to audit log. minimal UX: button + reason input + rate limit. i sketched a mock in /console/patch.
maya: ops-bot created INF-4321 to track rescue-token implementation and audit needs.
ops-bot: Ticket INF-4321 created by maya 1 replay, quota, console-ux9.
ryan: running the API call to bump priority now. curl:```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api/replay/jobs/claim/priority" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"job_id":"replay-20250310-01","priority":"high","ttl":"30m"}'
```
ryan: done, priority bumped. dry-run retried and shard claims succeeded; LeaseTimeoutError gone.
priya: dry-run completed with no divergence. plan: run prod reprocess in ~15m under bumped policy, then revert and follow up to implement the rescue token + console button.
trent: after the run let's capture token usage and add console guards (team rate-limits, per-day caps). also instrument metrics: rescue_token_issued{team,env}, rescue_usage_success_ratio, rescue_fallbacks.
zara: i'll open a PR for UX + token endpoint tomorrow. keep the API surfaces minimal and require audit message.
ryan: prod run started. watching agg-freshness and replay-claims dashboards. will ping if claims spike or latency regression shows. :eyes: 
priya: thanks all.
ryan: :thumbsup:
